name: Fetch YouTube Show-transcript text via a language-aware track ladder
goal: Fetch the best English Show-transcript text for a YouTube video by listing every transcript track and walking a fixed ladder: manual English > auto English spoken in the original audio > YouTube-translated track (tlang=en) > English auto track of an AI-dub audio track > original-language track plus offline machine translation. Handle 429/IP blocks, removed videos, and disabled transcripts honestly. Delta vs generic transcript fetchers (youtube-skills, youtube-fetcher): it tells original audio apart from YouTube AI-dub tracks, keeps the original words beside any translation, and logs every decision.

outputs.name: transcript
outputs.description: raw/<id>/transcript.txt (panel style m:ss + text; '#' header line when translated)

outputs.name: meta
outputs.description: raw/<id>/meta.json: route, language_code, is_generated, translated, translation_method, decisions[], retries[]

constraints: Transcript source is YouTube's Show transcript panel text (info section -> Transcript); say 'transcript', not 'captions'. Caption-file transports (.srt/.vtt) are only used internally and deleted.
Never invent transcript text, steps, or settings; every downstream fact must trace to a transcript timestamp.
No Whisper/ASR on the audio unless Matt explicitly asks; the router may only FLAG it as a last resort.

Detect the original spoken language from yt-dlp metadata ('language' and '<lang>-orig' auto tracks). Many videos list 10-17 auto tracks because of YouTube AI dubbing; an English auto track on a German-original video is dub-derived, not the creator's speech.
Retry with exponential backoff only on 429 / RequestBlocked / IpBlocked. Terminal errors (VideoUnavailable, TranscriptsDisabled, AgeRestricted) stop at once.
A proxy (YT_TRANSCRIPT_PROXY) or cookies file (YTDLP_COOKIES) may be used only if Matt configured it; never harvest browser cookies or credentials to get around a block.
The YouTube tlang translation endpoint is rate-limited more aggressively than plain tracks. When it 429s, fall through to the original track + machine translation instead of hammering it.

steps.action: Probe the video with yt-dlp -J --skip-download: confirm it is available and read the original language (info.language or the '<lang>-orig' auto-caption key). Map yt-dlp errors: 'unavailable/private/removed' -> video_unavailable; '429' or 'Sign in to confirm' -> rate_limited_or_ip_blocked.
steps.expect: original_language known, or a classified error

steps.action: List transcript tracks with youtube-transcript-api (list only): language_code, is_generated, is_translatable, translation_languages. Wrap the call in a 429-only backoff (4 s, 8 s, 16 s plus jitter).
steps.expect: Track list, or a terminal/blocked error

steps.action: Build the ladder: rank 1 manual target-language; rank 2 auto target-language when the original language is the target (or unknown with a single auto track); rank 3 tlang=target from the original-language track (manual before auto), never when that track is already the target; rank 4 target auto track when the original is another language (dub-derived); rank 5 original-language track + machine translation.

Try rungs in order and stop at the first that fetches. For rank 3 keep the original-language words too (transcript.orig.<lang>.txt). For rank 5 save the original panel and run translate_transcript.py in .venv-translate; if it fails or comes back garbled, stop with error translation_failed and keep the original.
steps.expect: transcript.txt in English plus provenance in meta.json

steps.action: If no rung works through the API, fall back to yt-dlp timed text (--sub-langs 'en.*,en,<orig>-orig,<orig>', or '.*-orig' when the original language is unknown), convert it to panel text, and delete .srt/.vtt files.
steps.expect: Panel transcript, or an honest failure

steps.action: On failure write meta.json with ok=false, the error class, decisions and retries. For transcripts_disabled / no_transcript_found set last_resort = 'ASR possible only if Matt asks'. Never write placeholder transcript text.

verification: meta.json has route in {manual-target, auto-target-original-audio, youtube-translated, auto-target-from-dub-track, original-plus-machine-translation, ytdlp-target} when ok
Translated routes have translated=true, translation_method set, and a transcript.orig.<lang>.txt next to transcript.txt
--list-tracks shows the planned ladder without fetching
